title: Coverage gap census (lite)
summary: One-page working census of small cross-team coverage gaps observed during last 2 weeks of rollouts. Purpose: create a minimal action lane, owners, and quick mitigations for each gap. Not exhaustive; meant to be scanned in 10s by oncall and product leads.
instructions: Scan rows, flag high-priority items (P0/P1). If you claim ownership, add ETA and update Status. Use shorthand: ETA format YYYY-MM-DD. Leave unresolved questions in the Notes column.
rows: Hosted API - regional routing,Users in eu-west fall back to smaller model frequently -> elevated latency and token cost,Latency 2x for ~5% traffic,Jordan Kim,Investigate routing rule overlap + temp pin model variant,P1,2031-10-09,in_progress,Root cause likely rule precedence; need routing logs from infra

Dedicated pools - burst isolation,Spiky SE load sometimes saturates reserved pool causing 503s for other customers,Intermittent 503s for 1-2 customers,Tom Baker,Add short-term soft-cap on per-tenant burst; long-term: tune autoscaler,P0,2031-10-10,blocked,Awaiting quota change from billing team (ticket JIRA-QUOTA-77)

Private deploys - onboarding checklist,Customers skip 'kv-cache warmup' step -> cold starts on first requests,First-request latency up to 4s for some flows,Priya Desai,Add prominent checklist item + sample script in install guide,P2,2031-10-15,open,Consider adding SDK warning on first call; low-risk

Fallback models - compatibility,Some older clients call legacy endpoint and hit a model variant that lacks function-calling -> malformed responses,Small subset of clients get parse errors,Elena Ramirez,Automated mapper to translate legacy calls to new function schema,P1,2031-10-12,in_progress,Prototype uses request header hack; needs perf testing

Observability - per-route traces,Missing per-route token-cost breakdown for canary routes -> blind cost spikes,Hard to attribute cost to rollout test runs,Jordan Kim,Enable token-level tagging on canary route, POC in observability stack,P2,2031-10-18,open,Work with observability eng to prioritize under Q4 roadmap

Autoscaler - warmup signals,Autoscaler scales-to-zero then slow to come back for rare sequences -> tail latency,Tail latencies for rare sequences >300ms,P0,Tom Baker,Add warmup traffic and maintain 1 standby replica for low-traffic routes,P1,2031-10-11,proposed,Short-term: scheduled ping; long-term: smarter load prediction

Support runbooks - contact lists,Oncall lacks up-to-date vendor contact for GPU partner during hardware incidents,Delays in escalation during infra incidents,Jordan Kim,Refresh vendor contact matrix and publish to ops channel,P2,2031-10-08,done,Added escalation phone and slack handles

Billing - reserved capacity alerts,No fine-grained alert when reserved pool approaches commit cap -> surprise overages,Potential billing exposure for finance,Elena Ramirez,Create reserve-cap threshold alerts + weekly digest to finance,P1,2031-10-14,open,Coordinate with finance; sample alert thresholds proposed
